rubric: The task is restated in one line; a given attempt is checked first and the first mistake is named and explained, not all at once.
Numbered steps with this exercise's numbers and a reason per step; intermediate results shown; the answer marked with its unit.
A check by a second way (substitution, size estimate, units) in one line; the reusable rule in one sentence; a similar practice item when learning.
Essays get a structure, a thesis sentence and the two strongest points, not a finished essay by default.
Level-fitting language; no invented facts or formulas; uncertainty named with where to check.
